skill: unscrew a bottle cap: twist_cap, extract_cap, check_cap (learning/twist.py)
source: logs/learning/bottle/episodes.jsonl: 12 real attempts, 03:19-04:48; curated excerpt in docs/learning/data/
how_to_read: docs/learning/PROFILES.md. Each entry: value (the default in force), baseline (the code value it replaces), attempts (the evidence), evidence (what the records show), date. A skill-config version (learning/skillcfg.py) may still override any of them at run time; revert to version 0 = these values.

history.change: first learned profile: round 1 (attempts 1-7) loosened the cap, round 2 (8-12) opened it

params.default.grip_torque_limit.evidence: 0.6 tripped the gripper motor j8 overload (status 0x20, load 200, attempt 5); 0.4 ran clean but the jaws crept up the cap and slid off in check_cap (attempt 6); 0.5 held in attempts 7-12 with zero j8 faults (j8 change 0-6 ticks per stroke) and opened the cap three times (9, 10, 12).

params.default.approach_z_offset_mm.evidence: 0/-4/-5 mm gripped high and the jaws slid up onto the cap's smooth top bevel (1-3); -11 mm was refused by the safety floor (4); -5.5 still slipped on the bevel (8); -6.5 kept the jaws on the cylindrical wall and opened the cap (9, 10, 12). For the 22 mm cap at cap_top 0.205 m it puts the TCP at 0.1885 m, 0.5 mm above the floor (cap lower edge - 5 mm): the deepest grip the floor allows.

params.default.twist_deg_per_stroke.evidence: 20 deg (1-2) and 25 deg (3-9) strokes turned 20.0 and 24.6 deg each; 32 deg strokes achieved 31.5 deg each with zero slip (10, 23 strokes) and opened a fully closed cap (10, 12). At the closer bottle of attempt 12 (y 0.177 m) the IK reached only 27 of 32 deg in strokes 6-11 (not fatal: the stroke ends there).

params.default.strokes.evidence: A fully closed cap comes free after ~350 deg: in attempt 10 the mean j7 load fell under 0.7 x the break-away stroke from stroke 11 (104 -> 70), 23 strokes (730 deg) then ran into the call timeout; attempt 12 opened a closed cap with 11 strokes (305 deg) and a 6.5 cm lift. 11 is a total per attempt: twist_cap stops at the time budget with the cap gripped and a second call resumes.

params.default.twist_speed.evidence: Slow (3 deg per 0.15 s) opened the cap in 9 and 10 with low wrist-roll loads (mean 104 falling to 45-57 as the thread let go). Medium opened it in 12 (the demo take) but at mean loads 153 -> 114, where the free signal never shows (docs/learning/CAP_FREE.md). Cost: 10.1 s per slow cycle vs 8.5 s medium; the time budget + resume absorbs it.

params.default.lift_per_turn_mm.evidence: 3-4 mm/turn raised the gripper 9-13 mm over 8 strokes and the jaws crept onto the cap's top lip (3, 6); 0 mm/turn (7-9) dragged; 1 mm/turn followed the thread in the opening runs 10 and 12 (gripper rose 8-12 mm in total, all in the first strokes).

params.default.yaw_start_deg.evidence: Starting the jaws 12 deg clockwise leaves the wrist roll room for the counter-clockwise strokes and the turn backs; used in every attempt from 5 on, including the three openings.

params.default.regrasp_backoff_deg.evidence: A full turn back (0 = the whole stroke) dragged the loosened cap clockwise on the return (3). The open jaws turn back 1 deg less than the stroke: 22 and 24 for 25 deg strokes (5, 6), 31 for 32 deg (10, 12). Keep it at twist_deg_per_stroke - 1 when the stroke changes.

params.default.j7_load_abort.evidence: The operator ran every attempt at 300; the highest wrist-roll load seen was 212 (attempt 12, medium, stroke 1), so 300 never cut a stroke and still stops a cap that binds.

params.default.grip_close.evidence: Close until the jaws stall on the cap (gap ~35 mm on the 44 mm cap's flats) in every attempt.

ik.search.evidence: Commit f63acfd: the least lean anywhere wins over the first lean near the current joints. The cap is then reached at 32-36 deg (9, 10, 12) instead of 38-41 deg (1-8) or 60 deg (the old order).

twist.side_lean_deg.evidence: Always approach from above (hover + guarded vertical descent): the side approach along the leaning jaws slid them onto the cap's bevel (round 1 lessons); every opening came from above with the least-lean IK (lean 32-36 deg at a bottle ~0.18-0.20 m out).

twist.stop_on_free.evidence: Attempt 10 kept twisting a free cap for 12 more strokes (to 730 deg) until the call timed out. Replaying all 12 attempts, the j7 free signal would have stopped attempt 10 at stroke 12 and fired in no attempt where the cap was still on (1-8).

twist.free_load_ratio.evidence: Attempt 10: break-away mean 104, thread turning 74-88, free 45-71: 0.70 x 104 = 73 is first undercut at stroke 11. The closest miss in an attempt where the cap stayed on: attempt 1, 63.0 vs 0.70 x 86.5 = 60.6 (ratio 0.73; also only 80 deg turned, under the minimum rotation).

twist.free_min_rotation_deg.evidence: A closed cap needed ~350 deg (attempt 10: free signal from 348 deg; attempt 12: 305 deg plus the lift). 0.8 x 350 = 280 keeps an early low-load stroke from calling a cap free that cannot be.

twist.time_budget_s.evidence: 24 slow strokes (attempt 10, 271 s) did not come back to the operator: the client's 120 s call timeout. 110 s leaves 10 s for the reply and its two camera images. 11 slow strokes (~111 s) plus the approach (~25 s) cannot fit one call: the call ends with the cap gripped and twist_cap resumes.

twist.cycle_s.slow.evidence: 23 slow 32 deg cycles (twist, release, turn back 31 deg, regrasp) in 233 s.

extract.lift_m.evidence: check_cap's 15 mm lift reported 'free' on caps still on the thread (1, 2, 7: the jaws slid up the cap) and 'unclear' on others (3, 6, 8). The operator then lifted 6-6.5 cm straight up with move_tcp while gripping (9, 10, 12): a free cap came out in the jaws with a ~35 mm air gap over the open bottle, obvious on camera. A lift longer than the ~16 mm the jaws hold of the cap separates the cases: a cap on the thread is lost from the jaws, a free one is carried.

object.about: What the twin needs to model the same cap (learning/bottle_twin.py DEMO_BOTTLE; sim-to-real parity).
object.evidence: Attempt 1 measured the cap 4.4 cm wide and 2.0 cm tall; the operator used cap_height 0.022 from attempt 5 on. cap_top_z 0.205 m and x/y -0.003..-0.010 / 0.177..0.201 in attempts 9-12 (the bottle moved closer after attempt 8). thread_free_deg: see params.default.strokes.
